WITH step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    orders.timespan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.recordvault) as distinct_count,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT orders.recordvault) AS REAL) / 999.0 as ratio
  FROM riskandmargin 
  INNER JOIN orders ON riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault 
  GROUP BY orders.timespan
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.timespan,
    step3.distinct_count,
    step3.ratio,
    step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio as difference
  FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4
  WHERE step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  SUM(step5.distinct_count) as result_col1,
  AVG(step5.ratio) as result_col2,
  AVG(step5.difference) as result_col3
FROM step5
